title: Where Is This Kid Now? Cindy Lou Who

slide.tag: CINDY LOU WHO · ALL GROWN UP

lines: Remember Cindy Lou Who, the little girl who wasn't scared of the Grinch?
This is her all grown up.
Her name is Taylor Momsen, and she was just a little kid when she starred next to Jim Carrey in How the Grinch Stole Christmas, back in 2000.
She's said she got bullied for years because of that role.
As a teenager, she landed Gossip Girl, playing Jenny Humphrey.
But while she was still a teenager, she started a rock band called The Pretty Reckless, and walked away from acting to do music full time.
And it worked. The Pretty Reckless became the first female-fronted band ever to get five number one songs on Billboard's mainstream rock chart.
In 2017, they opened for Soundgarden at Chris Cornell's final show.
And in 2024, while opening for AC/DC in Spain, she got bitten by a bat on stage, and had to get rabies shots.
From Whoville to opening for AC/DC.
Follow for more where are they now, Christmas edition.
